text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That time went into extra prospect calls, not more paperwork.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were more complete and consistent. Next steps actually appeared in the record.

**3. Consent matters.** Some buyers hesitated at first. Asking upfront, and explaining how recordings are used, turned most hesitation into trust.

**4. Accuracy isn't perfect.** Product names and jargon needed cleanup. A quick review habit fixed it.

**5. Managers coached more.** Searchable call summaries made one-on-ones more specific.

Our takeaway: the tool didn't replace judgment. It freed reps to use it.

What has your team learned from AI tools?
